text:
maria.g: Heads-up — eu-west deploy window starts in 10m. Routing 10% traffic to service/embed v2. Please watch p95, 5xx, and error-budget. I'll post rollout URL.

deploy-bot: [deploy] started rollout embed-service:v2 -> traffic 10% (eu-west). CI: ✅, smoke: running.

sre-oncall: :eyes: hooking up dashboard now. Pulling p95 and 5xx panels. will watch 1m/5m windows.

leo.k: FYI we had a small kv-cache regen last night, might increase latency tail for short bursty workloads. watch tail latencies.

maria.g: noted. prioritizing p95 and 5xx over avg latency. set alert thresholds to 2xx->5xx spike rules.

sre-oncall: alert fired: embed-service 5xx rate 0.8% over baseline in last 2m (threshold 0.5%). tagging as possible deploy-related. :rotating_light:

infra-bot: incident-temp-channel created: #incident/embed-5xx-spike-2147601112.

anya: seeing increased 503s, logs show upstream grpc timeouts to model-host-3. sample: `rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing`.

leo.k: can we confirm model-host-3 CPU/IO? tagging infra.

infra-bot: model-host-3: CPU 92%, disk IO high, restarted infer-worker at 2147601260.

maria.g: hold traffic ramp. deploy-bot set traffic to 0% for embed-service:v2. command: `deploy-bot rollback --service=embed-service --target=v1 --reason="5xx spike model-host-3"`

deploy-bot: traffic rollback executed -> embed-service:v1 now 100% (was v2 10%). Canary cancelled.

sre-oncall: 5xx back to baseline (0.12%) after rollback. p95 tails improved. closing incident after 10m stable.

leo.k: recommend we add model-host health check to preflight and increase margin for that machine. file follow-up RFC.

maria.g: Agreed. I'll open a release-note entry: "embed-service v2 paused due to model-host-3 instability; rolled back to v1. Action: add preflight host health check and autoscale config." cc @infra. :memo:

anya: saved logs + traces at https://observability/redwood/embed/2147601112 for postmortem.

maria.g: thanks all. re-schedule a slower canary once infra fix deployed. :thumbsup:
